'''Kar'eme''' was a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] in the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] during the Imperial era.

==Biography==
Kar'eme was originally from [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] who served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and was later part of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] from the moment of its conception. He served in the ISB as a tactical team leader and lead an ISB team in an attack on a loyalist safehouse on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Afterwards, he also attacked an [[Alderaanian Resistance]] team that tried to return to the safehouse.

==Personality and traits==
Kar'eme wasn't keen on spying on intelligence gathering, but viewed what he did with the ISB as necessary for the stability of the Empire. He could speak [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Basic]], [[Bocce/Legends|Bocce]] and [[High Galactic (language)|High Galactic]].
